blocks.heading: A luxury sanctuary on Kaua‘i, now available anywhere
blocks.description: Discover signature treatments, holistic therapies, and personalized care designed to restore balance and elevate your well-being. Visit us on Kaua‘i or experience Saltay from wherever you are.

paragraphs.text: Our signature massage experiences are personalized therapeutic rituals designed to release deep-seated tension, restore healthy circulation, and bring your nervous system into a profound state of rest.
Each session is customized to your specific needs — whether you seek relief from chronic pain, recovery support, or a deeply restorative escape.

Drawing on thousands of years of Traditional Chinese Medicine, our acupuncture and energy medicine sessions restore the free flow of vital energy throughout your body — encouraging balance, vitality, and emotional wellbeing.

Our botanical rituals are immersive, plant-based experiences that honor the healing intelligence of nature. Each ritual is custom blended with locally sourced botanicals, minerals, and ocean-inspired elements.

columns.title: Immersive & In-Person Care
columns.body_html:
• Spa Packages & Day Rituals: Curated combinations (like the Saltay Sanctuary Reset or Nourished Restoration) for guests seeking a half-day escape.
  • Personal Retreats & Apprenticeships: Multi-day journeys for self-discovery, mastery, and master practitioner training modules.
  • Workshops: Local educational events rooted in foundational botanical medicine.

columns.title: Metaphysical & Remote Support
columns.body_html: Remote Healing & Energy Work: Tapping into subtle fields via Remote Acupuncture, Spirit Vision Readings, and Multi-dimensional Root Chakra Healing.
